displayName: OCI-MOB-007: Mobile — Sensitive Data in Logs
description:
Detects sensitive data such as tokens, passwords, or PII logged by mobile applications in cleartext

⚠️ NEEDS-REWRITE: Query is generic SQL, needs conversion to Cloud Guard detector condition

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_general_mob_007", "data__json.rEventName" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'AuditEvents' AND "data__json.rEventName" LIKE '%mobile%' AND "value" > 0
